_how_to_use: Edit this file by hand. One entry per Telegram display name exactly as it appears in the exports (see the Person dropdown in the board).
Only add a role that is well known AND verifiable: an on-chain address, a DAO proposal, a validator page, a public announcement. Put the proof in 'verified'.
aliases = other display names the same person has used (the board merges them under the first name).
Roles appear as badges next to the name, in a Role filter, and in the By-person view. Nothing here changes any label.
Rebuild the board after editing: python build_board.py
